newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off, market awaits mini-band drop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off, market awaits mini-band drop.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0326 to the dollar on continued dollar inflows in the commercial foregin exchange market, with players awaiting a drop in the real/dollar mini-band in coming days.
Dealers said the market is expecting Wednesday the first decline this month in the real/dollar mini-band, with a likely drop of 0.1 percent.
The current trade level was set November 28 between 1.0325 and 1.0375 reais per greenback.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Tuesday surplus of $60 million.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed flat at 1.0381 to the dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real fell 0.46 percent to close at 1.090 per greenback, traders said.
